title: RedSpark SFT record
$comment: Assistant turns are thinking-format: `content` carries an inline <think>...</think> block followed by the answer. The chat template splits that block back out, so reasoning lives inside `content` and no separate reasoning field is accepted. This file is the machine-readable declaration, for editors and CI; `data/validate.py` is the executable gate and a strict superset of it, adding the rules a pattern cannot express readably (exactly one <think>/</think> pair, nothing but whitespace before the opening tag, no empty answer) plus the advisory warnings. Nothing in this repository runs this schema, because jsonschema is deliberately not a project dependency; keep the two in step when either changes.

content.$comment: Leading whitespace is allowed because data/validate.py only requires the text before <think> to be blank; anything non-blank there is silently dropped by the template and is rejected by the validator.
